scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
You've never heard of me? Why, I'm the Veteran Blacksmith of this land. I've spent 30 years in this hot and bloody hellfire, bending steel to my iron will!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
你竟然没听说过我？哼，我可是这片土地上的资深铁匠。在这炎热血腥的地狱火中，我挥锤锻打了三十年，将钢铁驯服于我的意志之下！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
But...
I am growing older and my prowess begins to fade with age. So I've invented something for young, hot, upcoming Blacksmiths, in hopes that they too will master my craft...
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
但是...
我日渐衰老，技艺也开始随岁月流逝。于是，我为那些年轻、热血、前途无量的铁匠们发明了一样东西，希望他们也能掌握我的技艺...

scripts.text: What is it?
scripts.translation: 什么事？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
We Blacksmiths must always manipulate steel under extreme heat, and the hot air and melted metals are more than most people can stand.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
我们铁匠必须在极度的高温下操控钢铁，而灼热的空气和熔化的金属，是大多数人无法忍受的。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
For the sake of our craft, our beautiful, yet masculine faces are put at risk...
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
为了这门手艺，我们那英俊而刚毅的面庞时刻面临着危险...

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
But with this wonder of technology, there's no need to worry! Behold, the ^3355FFWelding Mask^000000 !!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
但有了这项科技奇迹，就无需担心了！请看，^3355FF钢铁面具^000000！！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
It works by covering your face with a fat metal plate. Truly, it's an item that everyone should want! If not yourself, it'd be a good idea to give this to a friend who is studying smithing.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
它的原理是用一块厚重的金属板遮住你的脸。这真是一件人人都应该拥有的物品！如果你自己不需要，送给正在学习锻造的朋友也是个好主意。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
So how about it ? If you give me ^2244FF50 Steel^000000 and ^4422FFonly 2000 Zeny^000000, I will make it for you right away~!!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
那么，怎么样？如果你给我^2244FF50块钢铁^000000和^4422FF仅仅2000 Zeny^000000，我马上就为你打造~！！

scripts.text: Hm... Not bad. Alright.
scripts.translation: 嗯...不错。好吧。

scripts.text: How does it work again?
scripts.translation: 它是怎么工作的？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
Ah, I see that you appreciate a Blacksmith's work! Alright, I'll do it right away !!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
啊，看来你很欣赏铁匠的手艺！好，我马上就做！！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
Hahaha~! Make good use of that!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
哈哈~！好好利用它吧！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
Hmmm...
You do not have the items I require.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
嗯...
你没有我需要的材料。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
A common Blacksmith would interpret this as a sign of disrepect, but I will forgive you. Just don't forget what I need if you want me to make you this mask.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
普通的铁匠会认为这是不敬，但我会原谅你。只要别忘了我需要什么，如果你想让我为你打造这个面具的话。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
The ^3355FFWelding Mask^000000 protects your face by covering it with a fat metal plate. This invention is the result of 30 years of endless toil at the hammer and anvil.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
^3355FF钢铁面具^000000通过一块厚重的金属板来保护你的脸。这项发明是我三十年在锤与砧之间无尽劳作的结晶。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith]
Ah...!
I guess this is the first time you've met a Blacksmith as great as me, and you're just speechless with awe. Please, take your time and speak up when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠]
啊...！
我想，这应该是你第一次见到像我这样伟大的铁匠，所以吓得说不出话来了。请慢慢来，准备好了再开口。

scripts.text:
^3355FFThis guy seems
a little full
of himself.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF这家伙似乎
有点自恋。^000000

scripts.text:
[Eric]
Please listen
to my story
of my blessed
grandfather.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
请听我讲讲
我那受祝福的
祖父的故事。

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交谈

scripts.text: Ask about Items needed
scripts.translation: 询问所需材料

scripts.text: Manufacture
scripts.translation: 制造

scripts.text: Quit
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text:
[Eric]
My Grandfather, who passed away a few years ago, was special to me. He always stayed with me, and took care of me. He was much better than my old man, who was always busy working.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
我的祖父几年前去世了，他对我很特别。他一直陪在我身边，照顾我。他比我那个总是忙于工作的老头子好多了。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
To me, Grandfather's library was always like a fantasy land where I could escape. I spent most of my time there.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
对我来说，祖父的图书馆就像是一个可以让我逃离现实的梦幻之地。我大部分时间都花在那里。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
I learned a lot of things from his books in the Library. Grandfather was interested in Alchemy and Music, and his Library was filled with many mysterious old books.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
我从图书馆里的书中学到了很多。祖父对炼金术和音乐很感兴趣，他的图书馆里收藏了许多神秘的陈旧的书。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
One day...
As usual, I went to the Library and discovered an interesting schematic.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
有一天...
像往常一样，我去了图书馆，发现了一张有趣的图纸。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
It showed some instrument which looked like Ear Muffs that, when worn on the head, could transmit music or whispers to the ears through a thin wire.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
那上面画着一种看起来像耳罩的装置，戴在头上后，可以通过一根细线将音乐或低语声传送到耳朵里。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
I guess...
It is my grand father's unfinished work. I met a few Alchemists and asked them to produce it, but they rejected my offer...
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
我想...
这应该是祖父未完成的杰作。我找了几位炼金术士，请他们帮我制作，但他们都拒绝了我的请求...

scripts.text:
[Eric]
In the end, I thought 'I've gotta make it myself.' So I researched for a few years, and now I fully understand how to make that thing. But, I could never gather the materials to make it!
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
最后，我想“我必须自己来做”。于是我研究了好几年，现在完全掌握了制作它的方法。但是，我始终无法集齐制作所需的材料！

scripts.text:
[Eric]
If I can get those articles, I would build it right away. If you are interested in my idea, would you bring them for me?
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
如果能拿到那些材料，我会立刻动手制作。如果你对我的想法感兴趣，愿意帮我带回来吗？

scripts.text:
[Eric]
All I wanna do is build this thing in honor of my grandfather and finish the work he started. If you ask me to keep it, I wouldn't mind.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
我只是想为了纪念祖父，完成他未竟的事业。如果你想要它，我不介意送给你。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
40 ^3355FFSteel^000000
1 ^3355FFOridecon^000000
1 ^3355FFAlcohol^000000
1 ^3355FFCoal^000000
These are the things I need for Grandfather's masterpiece.
*Tap! Tap! Tap!*

[Eric]
Thank you.
Because of you, I could accomplish my grandfather's wish. He would be happy if he looked down on me from Heaven.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
谢谢你。
多亏了你，我才能完成祖父的心愿。如果他在天上看到这一幕，一定会很高兴的。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
As I said, please take this. I am just proud that I can make this by myself.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
如我所说，请收下这个。能亲手制作出它，我感到非常自豪。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
Thank you for trying to help me, but you didn't bring all the items I need. I think you will find them all soon though.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
谢谢你试图帮我，但你没有带齐我需要的所有物品。我想你很快就能找齐的。

scripts.text:
[Eric]
N-no?
Well...
You have your own
worries, I suppose.
Farewell.
scripts.translation:
[埃里克]
不...吗？
好吧...
我想你也有自己的烦恼。
再见。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Hello, I'm Nia, the fifth
disciple of Mawong, the
gaming mastermind. Now,
how would you like to play a
Number Match game with me?
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
你好，我是尼娅，游戏大师毛翁的第五个弟子。现在，你想和我玩一局数字匹配游戏吗？

scripts.text: Number Match Game?
scripts.translation: 数字匹配游戏？

scripts.text: Practice Number Match
scripts.translation: 练习数字匹配

scripts.text: Play Number Match
scripts.translation: 开始数字匹配

scripts.text: Record Holder
scripts.translation: 纪录保持者

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Ah, well, the objective of
the Number Match game is to
guess the number I'm thinking
of. Of course, there are a few
rules that limit the numbers
that I can choose from.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
啊，好吧，数字匹配游戏的目的是猜出我正在想的数字。当然，有一些规则限制了我可以选择的数字范围。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
All the numbers that I make
up must be 3 digits, I can't
use 0 for any of the digits,
and I can't use the same
number for any of the digits
more than once.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
我编的数字必须是三位数，
任何一位都不能是0，
而且每一位数字也不能重复。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
So, for example, I can't
use the numbers 103, 112,
252, or 701. Those numbers
either have a 0, or they use
the same number in the digits
more than once. Got it now?
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
比如，我不能用103、112、
252或701。这些数字要么包含0，
要么有重复的数字。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Now, you only get 5 guesses,
and after each guess, I'll tell
you how many digits you guessed
correctly, followed by the number of correctly guessed digits in
the correct digit place.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
你只有5次猜测机会，
每次猜测后，我会告诉你猜对了几个数字，
以及其中有多少个数字位置也是正确的。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
For example, let's say the
number I come up with is 168.
If your first guess is 678, then you guessed two of the digits,
6 and 8, correctly. However,
only 8 is in the correct place.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
举个例子，假设我想的数字是168。
如果你第一次猜678，那么你猜对了两个数字，
6和8。但是，只有8的位置是正确的。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
You know, it'd be a good idea
if you try the Practice Mode
first. Then, when you're more
comfortable, play the actual
Number Match game. Don't forget that speed counts for your score!
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
建议你先试试练习模式。
等你熟练了，再玩正式的数字匹配游戏。
别忘了，速度也会影响你的得分哦！

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Ah, if you happen to
make a new record in the
Number Match game, you'll
have your name recorded,
so don't miss this chance for
fame and maybe even fortune~
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
啊，如果你在数字匹配游戏中
打破了新纪录，你的名字会被记录下来，
所以不要错过这个成名甚至发财的机会哦~

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Great, let's do a practice
Number Match game. Please
try to guess my number, okay?
If you want to cancel, then please enter a number greater than 1,000.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
很好，我们来玩一局练习模式的数字匹配吧。
请试着猜我的数字，好吗？
如果你想取消，请输入一个大于1000的数字。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Great, let's play Number Match!
You will have 5 chances to guess the number that I'm thinking of.
If you want to cancel, then please enter a number greater than 1,000.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
很好，我们来玩数字匹配吧！
你有5次机会来猜我正在想的数字。
如果你想取消，请输入一个大于1000的数字。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
^ff0000{0}^000000 is the
record holder for the Number
Match game with a time of
^ff0000{1} minutes, {2} seconds^000000.

[Nia]
Take care of yourself,
adventurer. If you ever
feel like playing a Number
Match game, come and talk
to me, alright? See you~
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
请照顾好自己，冒险者。
如果你想玩数字匹配游戏，
随时来找我，好吗？再见~

scripts.text:
[Nia]
You've canceled the
Number Match game.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
你取消了数字匹配游戏。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
You entered one of the
digits as 0, or input the
same numerical value in
the digits more than once.
Please enter another guess.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
你输入的数字中包含0，
或者有重复的数字。
请重新输入一个猜测。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
^ff0000{0}^000000,
your guess is ^0000ff{1}^000000.
Give me a moment to
come up with your results.

[Nia]
Yes, the number that
I guessed was ^ff0000{0}^000000!
Congratulations, you
just won this practice
game! Now you should be
ready for the real thing~
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
是的，我猜的数字是^ff0000{0}^000000！
恭喜你，你赢得了这局练习赛！
现在你应该准备好挑战正式比赛了~

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Great! You guessed
my number, which was
^ff0000{0}^000000. You finished in
^ff0000{1} minutes, {2} seconds^000000,
breaking the previous record
of ^ff0000{3} minutes, {4} seconds^000000.

[Nia]
^ff0000{0}^000000
set that old record,
but now you are the
new person to beat in the
Match Game. Congratulations
for setting a new record!
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
^ff0000{0}^000000
保持着那个旧纪录，
但现在你是新的纪录保持者了。
恭喜你创造新纪录！

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Nice work, you guessed
my number! The answer, of
course, was ^ff0000{0}^000000. You managed
to guess this number correctly
in ^ff0000{1} minutes, {2} seconds^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
做得好，你猜出了我的数字！
答案当然是^ff0000{0}^000000。你用时^ff0000{1}分钟，{2}秒^000000猜对了这个数字。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
^ff0000{0}^000000 is
the current Number Match
record holder with a time
of ^ff0000{1} minutes, {2} seconds^000000.
Good luck, and hopefully you
can break this record someday~
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
^ff0000{0}^000000是目前的数字匹配纪录保持者，
用时^ff0000{1}分钟，{2}秒^000000。
祝你好运，希望有一天你能打破这个纪录~

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Your guess has ^ff0000{0}^000000 of the
correct numbers. ^ff0000{1}^000000 of the
digits in your guess have
the correct number in the
correct digit placement.
Alright, try it again~
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
你的猜测中有^ff0000{0}^000000个数字是正确的。
其中^ff0000{1}^000000个数字的位置也是正确的。
好了，再试一次吧~

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Your last guess had ^ff0000{0}^000000
of the correct numbers,
and ^ff0000{1}^000000 digits in your guess
had the correct number in
the correct digit placement.
The answer was ^ff0000{2}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
你上一次的猜测中有^ff0000{0}^000000个数字是正确的，
并且有^ff0000{1}^000000个数字的位置也是正确的。
答案是^ff0000{2}^000000。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Your last guess had ^ff0000{0}^000000
of the correct numbers,
and ^ff0000{1}^000000 digits in your guess
had the correct number in
the correct digit placement.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
你上一次的猜测中有^ff0000{0}^000000个数字是正确的，
并且有^ff0000{1}^000000个数字的位置也是正确的。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Your last guess had ^ff0000{0}^000000
of the correct numbers,
and ^ff0000{1}^000000 digits in your guess
had the correct number in
the correct digit placement.
You have four guesses left.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
你上一次的猜测中有^ff0000{0}^000000个数字是正确的，
并且有^ff0000{1}^000000个数字的位置也是正确的。
你还剩四次猜测机会。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Your last guess had ^ff0000{0}^000000
of the correct numbers,
and ^ff0000{1}^000000 digits in your guess
had the correct number in
the correct digit placement.
You have three guesses left.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
你上一次的猜测中有^ff0000{0}^000000个数字是正确的，
并且有^ff0000{1}^000000个数字的位置也是正确的。
你还剩三次猜测机会。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Your last guess had ^ff0000{0}^000000
of the correct numbers,
and ^ff0000{1}^000000 digits in your guess
had the correct number in
the correct digit placement.
You have two guesses left.
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
你上一次的猜测中有^ff0000{0}^000000个数字是正确的，
并且有^ff0000{1}^000000个数字的位置也是正确的。
你还剩两次猜测机会。

scripts.text:
[Nia]
Your last guess had ^ff0000{0}^000000
of the correct numbers,
and ^ff0000{1}^000000 digits in your guess
had the correct number in
the correct digit placement.
You only have one guess left...
scripts.translation:
[尼娅]
你上一次的猜测中有^ff0000{0}^000000个数字是正确的，
并且有^ff0000{1}^000000个数字的位置也是正确的。
你只剩最后一次猜测机会了...
